name: Festerhulk

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.summary: Ignores Difficult Terrain made by plants or fungi.
traits.text: The festerhulk ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

traits.name: Spore Cloud
traits.summary: At the end of its turns, everything within 5 ft takes 3d6 Necrotic and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn; a Giant or Humanoid killed by it rises 24 hours later (Festerhulk, or Zombie).
traits.text: At the end of each of the festerhulk's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation around it takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. A Giant or Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a new creature 24 hours later: a Festerhulk if it was a Giant, a Zombie if it was a Humanoid.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.summary: Takes 10 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in it.
traits.text: The festerhulk takes 10 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Fetid Slams, and Slime Mold too if it is ready.
actions.text: The festerhulk makes two Fetid Slam attacks and uses Slime Mold if it is available.

actions.name: Slime Mold (1/Day)
actions.summary: Once a day disgorges a ravenous slime mold into a free space within 20 ft: a Black Pudding that is a Medium Plant, acting on its initiative and dying after an hour.
actions.text: The festerhulk spews a mass of ravenous slime mold into an unoccupied space within 20 feet. The mass uses the Black Pudding stat block, except that it is a Plant and Medium. It acts on the festerhulk's Initiative. It, and any masses it Splits into, dry up and die after 1 hour.

summary: A giant's corpse run by fungus: it pounds with huge rotting fists, chokes its surroundings with poison spores and spits out a hungry slime mold; sunlight sickens it.
